units.name: Department of Operations and Supply Chain Management
units.evidence: Official business-college faculty profile explicitly names the current Ajman Department of Operations and Supply Chain Management; describes operations planning, supply chain analytics and logistics teaching/research.

decisions.reason: Generic Data Analytics label does not name a verified operations unit; retain separately verified full operations department name instead.

sources.note: Names Department of Management and Marketing within College of Business Administration; overview does not establish a separate operations area.
Verifies industrial and systems engineering degree with operations research and supply chain curriculum; does not name its host department.
Lists electrical/computer, biomedical, IT, civil and mechanical departments; no separate industrial engineering department listed.
Program tab lists mechanical engineering only; industrial engineering host not verified.
Official faculty Experience identifies Department of Operations and Supply Chain Management at Ajman University, August 2024-present; research and teaching confirm operations scope.

limitations: Industrial and Systems Engineering degree is verified, but its current departmental host remains unresolved; do not publish degree as department.
Operations department name is supported by official faculty Experience; a dedicated department page was not verified.
